hens_rule_text: Up to 12 hens allowed in the city, kept in a proper enclosure; no roosters.
permit_notes: No permit mentioned on the city's own FAQ; only an enclosure requirement.
setback_notes: The city's FAQ requires only that hens be kept in a proper enclosure; no specific setback distance is given.
coop_rules: Hens must be kept in a proper enclosure; other fowl (ducks, geese, guineas, peacocks, turkeys) are banned entirely.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: City of McKinney, TX, official FAQ: Am I allowed to have chickens in the city limits?
Community Impact, McKinney city ordinance allows chickens; some HOAs do not

research_notes: Read the city's own official FAQ page directly (fetched successfully): it plainly states up to 12 hens are allowed with a proper enclosure, no roosters, and lists the other banned fowl. No numeric setback is published; the FAQ does not mention a permit.
